_readme: Homepage copy, section by section (docs/PLAN.md §4). status: approved = brief or Parth's words, checked verbatim by scripts/check-copy.js. status: draft = written for review; blocks launch until approved (npm run check:launch).

hero.h1: We rethink how your business works, and build what comes next.
hero.sub: We partner directly with ambitious founders to transform operations, discover new opportunities, and engineer the solutions that bring them to life.

transition1.heading: We're not consultants. We're builders.
transition1.text: Consultants hand you a report. We own the outcome with you.

panels.title: Transform what exists
panels.body: Fix how the business runs today. We remove the bottlenecks and engineer the systems that keep it moving.

panels.title: Discover what's next
panels.body: Find the next product, market or revenue stream. Then we build it and bring it to life.

philosophy.text: A company's future should not be limited by the way it operates today.

steps.title: Founder conversation
steps.body: You tell us the real problems.

steps.title: Deep audit
steps.body: We go inside the business and study operations, numbers, spend and where the effort goes.

steps.title: Proposal with impact
steps.body: A specific solution and its expected impact.

steps.title: Implement, your way
steps.body: We build it, build it with your team, or guide your team through it.

frontier.title: Built for a moving frontier
frontier.text: AI changes every few months. Our solutions are designed to adapt with it. Delivered in months, not years.

items.title: Senior technology leadership
items.body: Parth has worked alongside senior technology leaders at global companies.

items.title: Operational resilience
items.body: Every business has operations it can't afford to lose. We find where they're fragile, strengthen them, and keep them running when things go wrong.

items.title: Financial anomaly detection
items.body: Founder experience in spotting unusual patterns in financial data before they become problems.

items.title: Automated research systems
items.body: Systems that gather evidence, synthesise it, check its quality and deliver structured reports.

contact.title: Have something ambitious in mind? Let's talk.
